title: StartHalo sl8-* E2B templates registry
description: Public, machine-readable inventory of the sl8-* family of E2B sandbox templates and their tool packs. Generated from studio/e2b/ in sl8-pipeline and manually mirrored to StartHalo/sl8-templates. Consumer requirements: REGISTRY-CONTRACT.md (in the generating repo).

schemaVersion.description: Major schema version. Incompatible changes bump this; consumers MAY refuse to parse files whose version they don't understand.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this snapshot was generated.

sourceCommit.description: Full 40-char git SHA of the sl8-pipeline commit this snapshot was generated from, or the literal 'uncommitted' for ad-hoc local runs.

templates.description: Every active sl8-* template, sorted with sl8-base first then alphabetically.

archivedTemplates.description: Templates that used to exist and have been replaced.

TemplateEntry.description: An active sl8-* template. Either has `components` (base templates) or `base` + `packs` (variant templates).

name.description: Template name. Matches the directory under studio/e2b/ in sl8-pipeline AND the generic alias.

status.description: Always 'active' for anything in `templates`; archived templates live in archivedTemplates. DO NOT widen this enum to express deprecation — consumers hard-filter on `status === 'active'` (@starthalo/bot-cli runtimes-registry), so a template still in service but closed to new work would vanish from every runtime list and fail `bot validate`. Deprecation is carried additively by `lifecycle`; consumer visibility by `ui.hidden`. (REGISTRY-CONTRACT.md R10 reserves a 'beta' state — not emitted by this generator today, and bot-cli would not list it; widen only with a coordinated consumer change.)

lifecycle.description: Whether this template is open to NEW work. 'deprecated' means still published, still resolvable, existing bots keep running — but nothing new should pin it. Absent means 'active', so entries written before this field remain valid. Orthogonal to `status`, which stays 'active' for the whole service life.

deprecation.description: Required iff lifecycle is 'deprecated'. Records why, and what still stands in the way of archiving.

since.description: Date the template was closed to new work.

reason.description: One line: why it is being retired.

successor.description: The template new work should use instead, or null when none exists yet. Null is the honest value — never point at a template that cannot host the workloads.

blockers.description: Consumers that must be migrated or retired before this template can be archived. GENERATED, not hand-authored — recomputed from every bot.yaml sandboxTemplate pin plus the studio registry, so it cannot go stale.

currentVersion.description: Timestamped version (vYYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) currently promoted for this template.

versioned.description: Pinned alias — '<name>-<currentVersion>'. Use for reproducible jobs. Never auto-updates.

generic.description: Floating alias equal to `name`. Resolves to whatever is currently promoted. Auto-updates on every promotion.

components.description: Installed tools/runtimes on a base template (e.g. sl8-base). Mutually exclusive with `packs`.

name.description: Canonical package name (e.g. '@anthropic-ai/claude-code') or runtime label ('Node.js', 'gcsfuse').

version.description: Version pinned at template build time. May be a full semver, a major-only marker ('20.x'), or 'system' for OS-provided components.

base.description: The base template this variant inherits from. Present on variants; absent on base templates.

version.description: Exact base version this variant's template.ts pins via fromTemplate(...).

packs.description: Tool packs layered on top of the base, in install order. Mutually exclusive with `components`.

ui.description: Curated display copy and brand (name, emoji, tagline, capability chips, accent, per-package blurbs). Under the Studio Registry Contract (REGISTRY-CONTRACT.md) every active template MUST ship either a contract-complete ui block or `ui.hidden: true` — the generator enforces this. Consumers fail closed: a non-compliant template is hidden from discovery and renders a neutral fallback for stored ids.

Ui.description: Curated display copy and brand for a runtime — the Studio's consumer identity per REGISTRY-CONTRACT.md. Authored in e2b/<template>/ui.json and embedded verbatim by the registry generator, which enforces the contract (R2–R8) on every non-hidden block.

displayName.description: The Studio's name (R2): Title Case, 1–3 words, unique case-insensitively across consumer-ready templates, consumer-grade. Never include the word 'Studio' — the app derives '{displayName} Studio' from it.

emoji.description: Exactly one emoji grapheme (R5), used on compact chips and admin surfaces (e.g. '🎬'). Avoid flags or politically-loaded symbols.

tagline.description: One sentence, sentence case, ends with a period (R3) — why you'd work here, written for a non-technical customer. Renders verbatim on the picker card and product page subtitle.

description.description: Multi-sentence body text for info popovers / detail pages. Two to four sentences: what it is, what's notable, when to pick it.

capabilities.description: Up to 6 short consumer-grade chips (R6) — 'Cutting & encoding', not package names. The app additionally filters chips through its lexicon at render time; an off-brand chip is dropped, not shown.

brand.description: The Studio's visual brand (R4). Required (with a complete accent) on every consumer-ready template.

hidden.description: true = deliberately not consumer-facing (R7): infrastructure image, base layer, or not-yet-launched product. Skipped by all consumer surfaces without being logged as a violation, and exempt from the other ui contract requirements.

packageOverrides.description: Per-component or per-pack friendly text, keyed by component.name (base templates) or pack.id (variant templates). Unknown keys are an authoring error.

name.description: Override of the technical name for display.

blurb.description: One friendly sentence aimed at a non-technical user. Skip the version — it's shown separately.

technical.description: Appendix-grade text for a 'show details' panel. Include version, key flags, operational caveats.

Brand.description: A Studio's visual brand (REGISTRY-CONTRACT.md R4). The accent must be complete — a partial accent is invalid; no half-brands.

logoSrc.description: Reserved; unconsumed by SL8 today. The mark is the ∞ glyph tinted by accent.solid.

solid.description: Single solid accent — rings, tints, focus. Should be distinct from other Studios' solids and legible on light and dark grounds.

PackEntry.description: A tool pack layered onto a variant template.

id.description: Stable ID (matches the pack directory under e2b/tool-packs/).

version.description: Semver. Bumped when install behaviour or agentGuidance changes.

agentGuidance.description: Concrete usage instructions for skills/agents using this pack's tooling. Also baked into /etc/sl8/capabilities.json inside the sandbox.

replacedBy.description: Current template consumers should use instead.
